caption: The drawing depicts two ornately designed metallic objects on a plain beige background. The larger object on the left side features a broad, flattened blade-like shape with an intricate, wavy, and scalloped edge, primarily colored in a light greenish-yellow with yellow accents along the borders and dark outlines emphasizing the details. The right side of this object terminates in a pointed flourish decorated with engraved starburst patterns and a central leaf motif, while the left side has a rounded base and a hole near the bottom corner. The smaller object, positioned to the lower right of the larger one, is a similarly ornate, curvilinear piece in yellow, featuring a scroll at one end and a slot in the center, accompanied by engraved dots and starburst decorations. Small red numbers "7" and "2" are placed next to the respective objects, and the name "Chas F. Moss 32." is written in red ink beneath the large object.
title: Patch Pocket, Butt Plate & Stock on Ky. Rifle
